Class WidgetTree

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.widgets.WidgetTree
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class WidgetTree extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Screen-owned input and layout state. This class has no Minecraft, OpenGL or scripting dependency. Coordinates passed to its pointer methods are scaled GUI coordinates. A caller supplies drawing and clipboard services only from a live client callback.
